## SetCookieOptions.expiryDebug property

If `true`<!-- -->, diagnostic information describing how the cookie's expiry was derived is attached to the stored [Cookie](./tough-cookie.cookie.md) and readable via [Cookie.getExpiryDebugInfo()](./tough-cookie.cookie.getexpirydebuginfo.md)<!-- -->. Defaults to `false`<!-- -->; when omitted, no diagnostic work is performed and no existing behavior changes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
expiryDebug?: boolean | undefined;
```
